content_blocks.label: clause_1._GRANTOR'S_NAME
content_blocks.text: Alberto R. Vega, hereinafter referred to as the 'Grantor', is of sound mind.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: Margaret S. Vega is appointed as Executor of this Will.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: All personal property of the Grantor shall be distributed as follows: to his daughter, Sofia Vega, and to his son, Carlos Vega, in equal shares.
